## Goal
Retained product validation must follow dependencies justified by the owning formula's current control reads. Same input means reuse; unrelated movement means no requested-root work; relevant movement refreshes only necessary dependencies. Equal reproduction preserves allocation and generation and does not evaluate downstream formulas.

## Evidence and prerequisite
Discovered during fz-tfn.46 on base ad0ac47d3. Exact generated-definition owner routing removes an invalid DefineFunction(old generated) attempt. Real success41 -> shifted-source success42 and success41 -> failed source -> repaired42 then expose stale retained product demand. Old incorrect routing returns42 only by executing that invalid old-generated job; exact routing stalls on old Function31 RuntimeDemand/ExecutableFacts. This is an observable regression that .46 cannot waive.
Logs: /tmp/fz-tfn46-generated-old-routing.log, /tmp/fz-tfn46-rooted-source-trace.log, /tmp/fz-tfn46-rooted-product-path.log. The rooted witness correctly selects Backend(main) -> ABI(main). ABI waits on Materialized(main) and Effects(main). Before Effects(main)'s producer can perform its first actual read of Materialized(main), ProductMemo::stale_dependency_inner walks its prior semantically-sorted dependency bag through old Effects(child31) -> Materialized(child31). The refreshed main body would remove that callee.
ProductDependencies unordered maps, recursive-group shared external-dependency union, and this validation shortcut predate .46. Synthetic producer tests now establish this defect independently on ad0 through the production drive seam; full source replacement has separate current evidence below.

## Required counterexamples
1. Reader first reads Selector, then conditionally OldChild. Selector changes to remove OldChild while OldChild becomes unavailable. No obsolete child producer attempt.
2. Selector is a wrapper whose upstream input changes while its own retained generation initially remains unchanged. Direct-generation-first checks alone are insufficient.
3. Both Selector and OldChild are directly invalidated. No product-kind/name/sort priority may decide correctness.
4. Recursive group: A reads Selector and conditionally recursive B; B reads OldChild then recursive A. Selector now removes B while OldChild is unavailable. Merging B's dependencies before A must not demand OldChild or change the answer. Renaming member keys/order must not affect correctness.
5. Equal Selector reproduction retains Reader's exact allocation/generation with zero Reader evaluations; still-required failed child remains an error. Shared alternative membership and recursive membership cycles remain correct.

## Strategy
Follow .agent/strategies/output-contract-loop.md: pin the ordinary and recursive controls on the current baseline, then repair the data model before expanding gates.
Replace, do not supplement, the unordered dependency-bag validation authority with actual producer-observation ownership. Retaining product-read order can represent ordinary control flow, but simply concatenating ordered maps for recursive members loses per-member control ownership. Design and test member-aware group ownership before implementation. Fact observations are reconciled World snapshots; verify their invalidation relationship instead of inventing unnecessary parallel traces.
Temporary displacement is not proof that a value changed. Preserve equal-value validation cutoff. No global rescanner, retry queue, duplicated dependency manager, speculative blanket parent reevaluation, kind-specific priority, display identity, or incidental ordering as authority.

## Deletions and work proof
Remove stale semantic-sorted traversal as authority and the recursive union mechanism to the extent it loses member ownership. Do not retain a second trace alongside authoritative maps. Reassess the uncommitted .46 rooted-frontier adapter: membership witness edges differ from ordinary value dependencies, so prove necessity through selective removal after the generic correction; remove the adapter if superseded.
Measure evaluations, obsolete-child attempts, validation visits, allocations and generations before/after. Unchanged/unrelated cases remain zero work; changed selectors eliminate obsolete work; equal reproduction wakes/evaluates no downstream consumer. Long dirty chains/shared paths must not introduce quadratic validation walks. Temporary probes/adapters/duplicate tests leave at cutover.

## Acceptance and workflow
Implement independently on the epic branch at the ticket boundary after safely parking .46-owned edits; preserve all unrelated files and the existing kdt.46 stash. One implementation agent, TDD, full relevant library/serial matrix/CLI/interp/native/AOT/determinism/strict lint/fmt gates, coherent docs, root independent artifact/work proof and a fresh scoped cold review before one commit/close. Push only behind green CI for preceding SHA. Restore .46 by explicit saved snapshot, resolve overlaps and revalidate its generated source repair and all failure/healthy-work controls.
This ticket blocks fz-tfn.46 and final epic cleanup; it is not permission to drop .46 scope or relax healthy work pins.

## Current implementation and verified evidence
The .46 candidate is parked in immutable stash288b1531c515bf02f4ac9375ae422e8eb3c1ad58; .48 is independent against ad0ac47d3. Implementation agent owns source/tests/docs/all Cargo; root owns staging/commit/close/push. No frozen candidate or acceptance-gate pass exists. Durable evidence: .agent/measurements/fz-tfn48-validation.md.
Ordinary product observations use one ordered IndexMap in ProductDependencies; reconciled World fact snapshots remain unchanged. Recursive members retain their own local/internal reads stamped with final co-published generations. External snapshot conflict rejection remains. Shared group dependency union, prior pending-attempt unions and successful publication's membership copy are removed. Each member retains one immutable Rc dependency owner so complete mutable validation borrows positioned edge keys without deep copies. Ordinary baseline already used Rc; recursive baseline shared one union allocation, so no unchanged-total-allocation claim. Product values retain equal allocations/generations.
The actual rooted read records its boundary among ordered product observations. Committed and live pending roots validate earlier controls before old membership; registration alone cannot authorize demand. Direct/indirect retained+waiting seed-replacement control RED26630 is GREEN78497;69 focused pull controls GREEN51845 (known chain excluded). Pending boundary resumption alone reduces N8 equal-chain packaging evaluations to2 but remains RED77211 at43 witness positions.

Immediately missing products can still batch. Failed provisional cycle checks must never authorize later siblings.
Public ProductValidation JSON allowlist/registration/roundtrip and focused12 validation controls GREEN51320. It reports dirty product vertices, product-edge scans, rooted witness positions, boundary refreshes and ordering comparisons. Same test telemetry must cover producer context reads.
Storage-move membership clone ablation RED32526 proves clone changes backing-element address; move restored. No claim of total allocator-call reduction: IndexMap has its own storage. Clean checked-set allocation and exact Rc retention remain separately observed.

## Source prerequisite split
Permanent48 source test is retained_closure_source_replacement_does_not_request_obsolete_products. Shifted-offset closure41->42 avoids separately tracked45 label collision; generated identity is read from LowerFunction's FunctionDefined output.
Generic ownership alone fails materializing obsolete31 (trace /tmp/fz-tfn48-source-product-trace.log). Witness ownership restores interp42. Phase trace /tmp/fz-tfn48-source-phase-trace.log has replacement marker142 and no old31 product requests afterward; baseline semantic fact-demand still attempts DefineFunction31 at173/190 while servicing current root/main prerequisites. .46 retains the stronger no-invalid-old-definition-job assertion after restore;48 asserts no obsolete product requests across typed executable and positioned product keys. Print probes removed.

## Current prototype and remaining blockers

Sparse DirtyWitness replaces the flat dirty HashSet and per-read sorting/permissions/path scanner. Upward marking creates only previously unindexed witness paths, without per-mark path allocation. Live IndexMap child links use constant-time selection/index/swap removal. Only active-path reparent may rewind; unindexed clean subtrees are not walked.
Fresh cold REDs prevent freeze:80848 fails newly inserted dirty sibling and off-active reparent because last/reverse traversal skips appended work. First-child/forward successor correction is GREEN24516. Production dirty A/B cycle-prefix+membership-chain test (terminal chunk18ed64) repeats40 ordinary edges atN8 versus bound8; Selector's equal reproduction establishes the dirty cycle through the real driver.
Always-deferred Validate requests were rejected analytically: R rooted-includes A/B, both ordinary-read R; separate fresh waits alternate A→B→A. No public result/queue implementation was added. Approved next correction invokes the SAME existing complete member validator+finish locally, preserving ALL nested rooted obligations in one checked proof, and leaves the registered owner present. This is not a new SCC/fixpoint solver or retained permission cache. Cycle-prefix work is now GREEN98217 across8/32/64. Two sibling root/value backedges and incomplete-backedge failure/repair are GREEN53455 (initially green under complete proof; rejected-design control, not baseline RED). Shared-ancestor RED43683 exposes23vs16 witness positions; RED99996 exposes1vs0 redundant active-reader refresh. Reusing the parent inspection already performed by pruning and deferring only the active reader Refresh restores original2N witness/N+1vertices/zeroedges/zerorefresh. Maintenance includes successor ascent, discarded active positions, node/marker/link changes and pruning inspections. No second store.
